captions.text: The white and brown dog is running quickly through the grass.
A boy in green jacket is riding a small motocross bike through the mud.
A group of children are walking down the sidewalk in a line with two adults.
One man wearing camouflage pants and green t-shirt stands with one foot on a square while another man wearing the same type of clothing reaches out with a baseball glove on his left hand.
A woman in a long black dress playing the violin with a black man in a striped shirt, while the other band member with guitar plays along.
A woman standing on a rock with one of her legs up and her arms up.
A small car decorated with flames and other paint is driving amongst a crowd with a tub and flags on the roof.
A guy with a gray shirt and blue jeans on his skateboard jumping off the side of a building or construction site.
